title: Dixie the Doxie says HI and night night
author: kimmagagal2
text: Dixie the Doxie says HI and night night 😂❤️❤️
blurb: Dixie the Doxie is sprawled belly-up in a cozy pile of blankets, red collar on and big eyes locked on the camera. Per the poster, this is her way of saying hi and night night all at once.
